mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_payment_dead_letter_task ( task_no, message_id, correlation_id, dead_letter_routing_key, target_system, replay_exchange, replay_routing_key, task_status, task_status_type, payload_snapshot, header_snapshot, replay_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{taskNo}, #{messageId}, #{correlationId}, #{deadLetterRoutingKey}, #{targetSystem}, #{replayExchange}, #{replayRoutingKey}, #{taskStatus}, #{taskStatusType}, #{payloadSnapshot}, #{headerSnapshot}, #{replayCount}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT task_no AS taskNo, message_id AS messageId, correlation_id AS correlationId, dead_letter_routing_key AS deadLetterRoutingKey, target_system AS targetSystem, replay_exchange AS replayExchange, replay_routing_key AS replayRoutingKey, task_status AS taskStatus, task_status_type AS taskStatusType, resolution_note AS resolutionNote, payload_snapshot AS payloadSnapshot, header_snapshot AS headerSnapshot, replay_count AS replayCount, DATE_FORMAT(last_replay_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastReplayAt, operator, DATE_FORMAT(resolved_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS resolvedAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM t_payment_dead_letter_task WHERE task_no = #{taskNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_payment_dead_letter_task SET task_status = 'READY_TO_REPLAY', task_status_type = 'warn', operator = #{operator}, resolution_note = #{resolutionNote}, resolved_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND task_status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'REPLAY_FAILED')

UPDATE t_payment_dead_letter_task SET task_status = 'MANUAL_RESOLVED', task_status_type = 'success', operator = #{operator}, resolution_note = #{resolutionNote}, resolved_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND task_status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'REPLAY_FAILED')

UPDATE t_payment_dead_letter_task SET task_status = 'REPLAYING', task_status_type = 'warn', operator = #{operator}, replay_count = replay_count + 1, last_replay_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND task_status = 'READY_TO_REPLAY'
UPDATE t_payment_dead_letter_task SET task_status = 'REPLAYED', task_status_type = 'success', updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND task_status = 'REPLAYING'

UPDATE t_payment_dead_letter_task SET task_status = 'REPLAY_FAILED', task_status_type = 'danger', resolution_note = #{resolutionNote}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND task_status = 'REPLAYING'
